mapper.select: select a.item_code , b.item_name , b.item_type , a.item_quantity from tbl_inventory a join tbl_item b on a.item_code = b.item_code where a.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into tbl_inventory (user_id, item_code, item_quantity) values (#{userId}, #{itemCode}, #{quantity}) on duplicate key update item_quantity = item_quantity + values(item_quantity)
